notes.title: The Archetype- Chapter 4
notes.content:
I'd like to begin by apologizing for the delay in updates. Personal life things had to be dealt with (including a new baby daughter-- they're tiny but a LOT of work :p) and an opportunity with a new project (more on that on our website!), but as PR/manager-of-temperamental-developers-and-keeper-of-his-health/sanity I promise I am working on a good schedule so that we can get chapter 4 out to you guys. 

Please ask away in the comments if you have any questions! 

-Sara Barreto

notes.title: Chapter 3
notes.content: After being institutionalized, Archty gets married to Betty, but his nightmares and fears follow him even in adult life. Play now chapter 3 of The Archetype. Contact us on mundiproject@hotmail.com to let us know what you think and show us your gameplay videos.

notes.title: The Archetype - Chapter 3 coming soon
notes.content:
We're proud to announce that chapter 3 of The Archetype saga is coming out in June, 2016. We're putting everything we have in this chapter and Archty now is married to Betty, living in a really small apartment. The entire chapter will take place in the apartment, so be prepared for some serious claustrophobia while being scared to death.

notes.title: Changes in MP Game Studios
notes.content:
I regret to inform that Rafael is no longer our lead designer. He received a proposal from a big company and decided to move on. 

However, Starwalker will also move forward. We are in contact with two new designers and they are already working with us. 

This game is an old dream of mine and it's becoming something really incredible.

Rafael's left us with chapters 1 and 2 complete. Now I'm developing chapter 3 with the help of the new designers. Rafael also left us the whole plot for the game and all we need to do is put it on code. 

Thanks for your support!

Aron Moreira
MP Game Studios

notes.title: Chapter 2 is released
notes.content: Archty has been sent to an Institution after what happened in his house, when he was 9 years old. Now, he's 18 and needs to face the death of his friend Jeremy, in which he is the prime suspect. He's been locked up until Dr. Laudenburg finishes talking to the police.

notes.title: Halloween Update - Chapter 2
notes.content:
- More work fixing chapter 2 and preparing it for release. 

I'd say we're about 70% of the way to releasing chapter 2 and the story's really coming together. 

- Added Jeremy and Susie's appearances on Chapter 2

- Substances found in the morgue fully functional now.

- More work on ENVY and LIBIDO for Archty.

- Dialogs for Nurse Betty completed, no voiceover yet.

- Voiceover for letters and notes added.

- Archty's deep psychosis Maze added to Chapter 2, with his memories of Chapter 1, including his lovely mother Emily.

- Flashlight functional and available

notes.title: The Mysterious 911 Call
notes.content:
Many people have been writing to us about the 911 call made by Lisa in the game. To answer all the questions, yes, the call is real. Until we can get in touch with Lisa Floyd herself and she gives us authorization to use the call, it will be replaced with a text written by us.



Update: We talked to Lisa Floyd and she said that the text at the end raises awareness and that's all she wants. So the call stays in the game.

Update: After a lot of discussion, we decided that to use the call, even with the author's permission, was not causing what was intended. Since it doesn't need to be an audio, we decided to put it written instead. The actual call has been removed.

notes.title: Welcome to the world of the Archetype!
notes.content:
First of all, me and MacKenzie want to thank everyone that helped us make this story possible, even with our limited 3d modeling and coding skills. We know that some players will recognize the mansion and the hospital in chapter 2 from the Unity Asset Store, but even if you know these environments, the story is still very fun to play and we hope everyone enjoys it. 

Special thanks to Zed and Vic, our dearest Youtubers, that played the game so many times, enjoyed it so much and actually finished chapter 1 in 6 hours of pure awesomeness on Youtube. 

Anyone that wants to get in touch with us, our Facebook is www.facebook.com/themundiproject and my personal skype is rafaelbarretobra

Feel free to ask us any questions or follow development of chapter 2. We would also like to remember that if you buy the game, you're buying all 4 chapters and they will be updated as they are ready to go. We are giving a couple of months for players to play chapter 1 and send their feedback, then we're releasing chapter 2 in late november. 

I hope you have fun!
